in_arabic.name: بَهمن
in_arabic.meaning: الاسم الذي يعني العمدة أو القائد في فارسية
in_arabic.long_meaning: البَهمن هو اسم فارسِيّ يعني العمدة أو القائد. يظهر هذا الاسم في القرآن الكريم في سورة يوسف آية 33. ويُعد هذا الاسم من الأسماء النبوية في الإسلام. يُستخدم هذا الاسم في الثقافة العربية والإسلامية لوصف الشخص الذي له القدرة العليا. يأتي هذا الاسم من اللغة الفارسية، التي تأتي من اللغة الأوربية. وبالتالي، يعد هذا الاسم من أهم الأسماء التي تعكس الثقافة الفارسية في الإسلام.

data.cultural_impact: The name Bahman has deep cultural roots in the Persian civilization, which is one of the oldest in the world. The term itself is linked to the Zoroastrian god Ahura Mazda, represented as the deity of wisdom, goodness, and divine guidance. Over hundreds of years, Bahman has been a symbol of prosperity, health, and happiness in Persian cultures, and has been adopted into various beliefs, including Sufism and Shia Islam.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic mysticism and Sufi practices, the name Bahman is believed to represent the month of Rabi'ul-Awwal, which is the month of the birth of Prophet Muhammad SAW. This signifies the arrival of blessings, blessings of peace and wisdom, which according to Islamic tenets, are essential for the spiritual growth and development of believers. The name Bahman, in its spiritual interpretation, embodies the attributes of God such as wisdom, guidance, and compassion. By embracing the name Bahman, one can seek its blessings in their daily lives and strive towards becoming closer to God.
